tours.title: Demo · Cheating under the IPC, co-accused already on bail
tours.story: Accused-1 is charged under IPC 420 and 406 for taking an advance of Rs. 6,50,000 for machinery that was never delivered; the offence (March 2024) predates the BNS, so the IPC governs. He has been in custody since 12.03.2024, the charge sheet was filed in time and the trial is under way; his earlier bail application was rejected, while Co-accused-2, with a comparable role, is on bail.

variant.offence: IPC 420/406 cheating (maximum 7 years), offence before 1 July 2024
variant.custody: default bail closed (charge sheet on day 55 of 60); 978 days in custody are past one-third of the 7-year maximum (852 days) but the radar applies the half threshold of 1,278 days, so BNSS s.479 shows NOT_YET (reached on 11.09.2027)
variant.parity: Co-accused-2 granted bail; first-time offender; earlier bail application rejected

hi.title: डेमो · IPC के अंतर्गत धोखाधड़ी, सह-अभ अभियुक्त पहले से जमानत पर
hi.story: Accused-1 पर IPC 420 और 406 के तहत मशीनरी के लिए 6,50,000 रुपये का अग्रिम भुगतान लेकर मशीनरी न देने का आरोप है; यह अपराध (मार्च 2024) BNS के लागू होने से पहले का है, इसलिए IPC लागू होती है। वह 12.03.2024 से हिरासत में है, आरोप-पत्र समय पर दाखिल किया गया था और विचारण जारी है; उसकी पूर्व जमानत याचिका खारिज कर दी गई थी, जबकि Co-accused-2, जिसकी भूमिका समान है, जमानत पर है।

variant.offence: IPC 420/406 धोखाधड़ी (अधिकतम 7 वर्ष), 1 जुलाई 2024 से पहले का अपराध
variant.custody: डिफ़ॉल्ट जमानत बंद (60 में से 55 वें दिन आरोप-पत्र); हिरासत में 978 दिन 7 वर्ष की अधिकतम अवधि (852 दिन) के एक-तिहाई से अधिक हैं लेकिन रडार 1,278 दिनों की आधी सीमा लागू करता है, इसलिए BNSS s.479 NOT_YET दिखाता है (11.09.2027 को पहुंचेगा)

tours.title: Demo · Attempt to murder under the BNS, co-accused on bail
tours.story: Accused-1 is charged under BNS 109 and 3(5) for a knife wound in a quarrel over parking on 13.03.2025, an attempt to murder. He has been in custody since 16.03.2025; the charge sheet was filed on day 81 of 90, in time. The Rights Radar takes the maximum punishment as death: default bail is WINDOW_CLOSED (the charge sheet came inside the 90 days) and the BNSS s.479 undertrial limit is NOT_APPLICABLE, because s.479(1) does not apply where the maximum is death or life imprisonment. His bail was refused by the Sessions Court, and Co-accused-2, said to have only held the injured, was granted bail by the High Court.
